title: Reusing Calibration Gains across Model Representations
abstract: arXiv:2610.22771v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scale calibration learns an update for one model representation. We study how much of that update can be reused by another representation of the same pretrained model. Our transfer procedure extracts positive group-wise gains and installs them in the recipient's weights or native quantization scales without recipient-side optimization. On a quantized recipient, it preserves integer codes, zero points and storage layout. For a Qwen3-1.7B floating-point/GPTQ INT3 pair, bidirectional transfer retains 76.9-90.5% of the text-loss improvement from recipient-specific calibration on fresh WikiText and C4 cohorts excluded from project development. Shuffling the same gain values within each projection worsens both recipients, showing that their learned group assignment matters after transfer. translated_title: 跨模型表示复用校准增益
translated_abstract: 尺度校准会为一种模型表示学习一个更新量。我们研究了同一预训练模型的另一种表示能在多大程度上复用该更新。我们的迁移方法提取正的分组增益，并将其直接安装到接收方的权重或原生量化尺度中，而无需在接收方一侧进行任何优化。对于量化的接收方，该方法保持整数编码、零点和存储布局不变。对于一个Qwen3-1.7B浮点/GPTQ INT3模型对，在未参与项目开发的全新WikiText和C4数据集上，双向迁移保留了接收方专属校准所带来的文本损失改进的76.9%至90.5%。在每个投影内打乱相同的增益值会使两个接收方的性能都变差，这表明其学习到的分组分配在迁移之后仍然重要。一项Llama-3.2-3B对照实验保持所有四个校准投影处的初始原生张量完全相同，而改变其他位置的九个投影。交叉安装……
tldr: 该论文提出一种无需接收方优化的迁移方法，可将一种模型表示上学到的尺度校准增益复用到同一预训练模型的其他表示（如量化模型）中，在保持量化存储布局不变的同时保留76.9%–90.5%的校准收益。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that scale calibration gains learned for one model representation can be transferred to another representation of the same pretrained model without recipient-side optimization, retaining 76.9–90.5% of the calibration benefit while preserving the quantized model's integer codes, zero points, and storage layout.
